events.title: PNM Resources: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
events.body: The Albuquerque, New Mexico-based company said it had a loss of 8 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, came to 48 cents per share. The power company posted revenue of $533.2 million in the period.
